settings_enrollment_display_download_lab: Display the “Download client” page during enrollment.
settings_enrollment_display_download_con: If your organization uses a centralized software distribution platform to install the client automatically on all devices, the download step during enrollment may be unnecessary. Disable this page to streamline the enrollment experience for end users.
settings_enrollment_page_subtitle: Configure enrollment settings to control how users join your instance and manage the enrollment flow.
settings_enrollment_display_password_res: Display the “Reset password” option on the Enrollment Service home screen.
In case your instance uses only an external SSO provider, XGuard’s internal password reset is not needed, as authentication is handled externally.
settings_enrollment_message_templates_su: This message will be shown at the end of enrollment process. Enrollment is a process by which a new employee will be able to activate their new account, create a password and configure a VPN device.
settings_enrollment_template_display_mes: This information will be displayed for user in service once enrollment is completed. We advise to insert links and explain next steps briefly.
settings_enrollment_template_send_email_: This information will be sent to user email once enrollment is completed. We advise to insert links and explain next steps briefly.
settings_enrollment_template_same_as_mes: Your email will contain the same text as the welcome message from the input above.

settings_enrollment_section_duration_des: Configure the expiration time of the unique token sent to a newly added user. This token is used to activate the account, and in this section administrators can control how long the token remains valid.
settings_general_section_client_behavior: Manage how users interact with the XGuard client. Control device management permissions, configuration access, and traffic routing options.
settings_activity_log_streaming_descript: Monitor and export real-time activity logs from your XGuard instance. Stream events to external systems for auditing, analytics, or security monitoring.
settings_activity_log_streaming_no_upstr: You don't have any activity log upstreams.
Click the button below to add an activity log provider and start streaming events.

settings_notifications_smtp_card_content: Configure your SMTP server to enable email notifications and system alerts.
settings_smtp_reset_confirm_body: Are you sure you want to reset SMTP settings? This action cannot be undone.
settings_smtp_reset_blocked_body: SMTP settings cannot be reset while these features are enabled. Disable them first:
settings_smtp_reset_confirm_body_mfa: MFA flows **{flows}** use email codes. Their users cannot complete MFA until those flows are edited. Are you sure you want to reset SMTP settings? This action cannot be undone.
settings_smtp_test_failed: Failed to send test email, check the logs for more information
settings_smtp_subtitle: Configure the SMTP server used to send system messages to users.
settings_smtp_section_server_description: Configure the SMTP server here — it’s required for sending system messages to users.
settings_smtp_test_email_description: Check if your SMTP configuration works by sending a test email.
settings_ldap_subtitle: Manage LDAP/Active Directory connection details, user and group mapping, and synchronization rules that determine how users are imported and updated in XGuard.
settings_ldap_section_connection_descrip: Configure LDAP connection settings here. These settings determine how XGuard connects to your LDAP server. Encrypted connections are also supported (StartTLS, LDAPS).
settings_ldap_checkbox_disable_password_: When enabled, users sourced from LDAP without a local password cannot change or reset their password through XGuard.
settings_ldap_section_user_description: Configure LDAP user settings here. These settings determine how XGuard maps and synchronizes LDAP user information with local users.
settings_ldap_helper_enrollment_token_at: Directory attribute that receives an enrollment token when you choose "Store enrollment token in LDAP" for users, so another system can deliver it. The value is JSON with enrollmentToken and enrollmentUrl, written only over LDAPS or StartTLS, and removed when the user finishes enrollment. Restrict read access to this attribute in the directory.
settings_ldap_error_forbidden_enrollment: This attribute cannot be used to store enrollment tokens.
settings_ldap_section_group_description: Configure LDAP group settings here. These settings determine how XGuard maps and synchronizes LDAP group information with local groups.
settings_ldap_section_sync_description: Control how XGuard synchronizes users with LDAP — disable sync, import users from LDAP, or keep both systems updated automatically.
settings_ldap_section_sync_warning: To enable LDAP synchronization, please fill out the form above first.
settings_ldap_sync_one_way_content: Changes made to users in XGuard are propagated to your LDAP directory.
settings_ldap_sync_two_way_content: XGuard pushes changes to LDAP as they happen and pulls changes back from LDAP at regular intervals. The authoritative source chosen below decides which system is treated as correct if the two ever drift apart.
settings_ldap_authority_block_descriptio: XGuard uses this to reconcile differences, for example when sync is first enabled or after losing connection to LDAP. The authoritative source is treated as correct: where an account exists in only one system, it is added to or removed from the other to match.
settings_ldap_authority_xguard_content: When reconciling, XGuard is treated as correct. Accounts that exist only in LDAP are deleted, and XGuard accounts missing from LDAP are added back to it.
settings_ldap_authority_ldap_content: When reconciling, LDAP is treated as correct. Accounts that exist only in XGuard are deleted, and LDAP accounts missing from XGuard are added to XGuard.
settings_ldap_test_connection_tooltip: To test the synchronization, please fill in all required fields first.
settings_ldap_section_remote_enrollment_: Let users synced from LDAP / Active Directory enroll remotely (enrollment portal or desktop client) with their directory username and password, and set up MFA there.
settings_ldap_helper_remote_enrollment_e: Directory users who have not finished enrollment can start it on the enrollment portal with their directory credentials. Until they finish, they count as not enrolled.
settings_ldap_label_remote_enrollment_se: Automatically invite new AD/LDAP users to enroll
settings_ldap_helper_remote_enrollment_s: When a sync adds new users, XGuard emails each of them an enrollment invitation with a personal token.
settings_ldap_remote_enrollment_warning_: Please activate LDAP synchronization and set up the SMTP server first to enable this feature.
Configure the SMTP server to send invitations.
Fill in the required connection and user settings first to enable this feature.
settings_client_subtitle: Manage user permissions and configuration options for device control, WireGuard setup, and VPN routing.
settings_client_permissions_description: Define which VPN client settings users can modify and which are restricted.
settings_client_device_management_conten: When this option is on, only Admins can add, edit and delete devices, or start a desktop client activation. Users can still enroll a device with a token an Admin issued for them.
settings_client_wireguard_configuration_: When this option is on, users can't view or download manual WireGuard configurations. Only XGuard desktop client setup will be available.
settings_client_disable_tunnels_content: When this option is on, users can't access or create manual WireGuard tunnels in the client. Existing tunnels are hidden across all configured instances.
settings_client_traffic_policy_descripti: Specify the conditions that determine how traffic should behave in the application.
settings_client_traffic_policy_none_cont: When this option is enabled, users will be able to select all routing options.
settings_client_traffic_policy_disable_a: When this option is enabled, users will not be able to route all traffic through the VPN.
settings_client_traffic_policy_force_all: When this option is enabled, the users will always route all traffic through the VPN.
settings_client_traffic_policy_group_des: Define the groups that should use their own traffic rules instead of the global traffic policy. Users in none of the groups below use the global traffic policy. When a user is in several of these groups, Disable all traffic wins over Force all traffic, which wins over No limitation.
settings_client_traffic_policy_group_non: When this option is enabled, users in groups will be able to select all routing options.
settings_client_traffic_policy_group_dis: When this option is enabled, users in groups will not be able to route all traffic through the VPN.
settings_client_traffic_policy_group_for: When this option is enabled, the users in groups will always route all traffic through the VPN.
settings_gateway_notifications_subtitle: Here you can manage email notifications.
settings_notifications_gateway_card_cont: Configure admin email notifications for gateway disconnect and reconnect events, and set the inactivity threshold that triggers disconnect notifications.
settings_gateway_notifications_smtp_warn: To enable notifications you must first configure SMTP.
settings_gateway_notifications_disconnec: Send an email notification to admin users when a gateway disconnects.
settings_gateway_notifications_reconnect: Send an email notification to admin users when a gateway reconnects.

settings_smtp_auth_oauth_popup_blocked: Authorization popup was blocked. Please allow popups for this site.
settings_smtp_auth_oauth_popup_closed: Authorization popup was closed before completing.

settings_device_limits_description: Limit how many devices each user can register and how many simultaneous MFA VPN connections they may hold per location. Set 0 for unlimited. Simultaneous connection limits apply only to MFA-protected locations (plain WireGuard locations do not have VPN sessions).
settings_device_limits_max_connections: Max simultaneous MFA connections per location
settings_device_limits_helper_override: Leave blank to inherit, or enter 0 for unlimited
settings_openid_page_subtitle: Let users sign in with an external OpenID Connect provider, such as Google, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta or Keycloak.
settings_openid_helper_issuer: The provider's issuer, for example https://accounts.google.com. XGuard reads its configuration from /.well-known/openid-configuration.
settings_openid_helper_secret_kept: Leave empty to keep the stored secret.
settings_openid_helper_redirect: Register {url} as a redirect URI at the provider. For sign-in through Edge (enrollment portal and VPN MFA), also register <Edge URL>/openid/callback and <Edge URL>/openid/mfa/callback.
settings_openid_label_create_accounts: Create XGuard accounts for new users with a verified email
settings_openid_label_disable_password_m: Users without an XGuard password cannot set one
settings_openid_test_failed: The provider could not be reached
settings_openid_delete_body: Users will no longer be able to sign in with it. Their XGuard accounts are kept.
settings_openid_sync_description: Keep XGuard accounts in line with the provider's directory: account status, accounts that leave the directory, and group membership. Check the settings with a dry run before turning it on.
settings_openid_sync_unsupported: Directory sync is available for Google, Microsoft, Okta and JumpCloud.
settings_openid_sync_google_help: Create a service account with domain-wide delegation for the scopes admin.directory.user.readonly and admin.directory.group.readonly, and paste its JSON key file below. XGuard acts as the admin you enter.
settings_openid_sync_helper_admin_email: A Workspace admin who can read users and groups.
settings_openid_sync_helper_google_key: Paste the contents of the service account's JSON key file.
settings_openid_sync_helper_key_kept: A key for {account} is stored. Leave empty to keep it, or paste a new key file.
settings_openid_sync_microsoft_help: XGuard uses the client ID and secret above with the tenant from the issuer URL (https://login.microsoftonline.com/<tenant ID>/v2.0). Grant the app the User.Read.All and GroupMember.Read.All application permissions, with admin consent.
settings_openid_sync_okta_help: Create an API service app with public key / private key client authentication, grant it okta.users.read and okta.groups.read, turn off "Require DPoP", and paste its private key (JWK) below.
settings_openid_sync_helper_okta_key: The app's RSA private key in JWK format.
settings_openid_sync_jumpcloud_help: Use the API key of a JumpCloud admin who can read users and user groups. The EU or India console is used when the issuer is in that region.
settings_openid_sync_helper_target: Account status, group membership, or both.
settings_openid_sync_helper_user_behavio: What happens to linked accounts that are missing from the directory or outside the user groups.
settings_openid_sync_helper_admin_behavi: The same for admins. The last active admin is never disabled or deleted.
settings_openid_sync_helper_group_match: Directory groups whose membership is synced, separated by commas; * and ? are wildcards. Leave empty to sync all groups except XGuard admin groups, which are synced only when named here.
settings_openid_sync_helper_user_groups: Only members of these directory groups are synced, separated by commas; * and ? are wildcards. Leave empty to sync everyone.
settings_openid_sync_prefetch: Create XGuard accounts for directory users who have none
settings_openid_sync_test_failed: The directory could not be read
settings_openid_sync_dry_run_description: A sync with these settings would make the changes below. Nothing has been changed.
settings_openid_sync_result_description: The sync made the changes below.
settings_openid_sync_stats: {users} directory users, {scope} in scope, {matched} linked to XGuard accounts; {groups} groups synced.
